homepage.heroSubtext: Authentic Japanese cuisine crafted with seasonal precision in the heart of the city.
homepage.chefBio: Born in Kyoto and trained in Tokyo's finest kaiseki restaurants, Chef Hiroshi brings two decades of mastery to every plate. His philosophy is simple: honour the ingredient, honour the season.
homepage.restaurantStory: Kaze — meaning 'wind' or 'breeze' — was born from a vision of Japanese cuisine that breathes. Ever-changing with the seasons, always rooted in tradition. We opened our doors in 2019 with a single promise: that every visit would be different, and every dish, unforgettable.
homepage.seasonalDescription: Cherry blossoms inspire our April omakase. Delicate, fleeting, and utterly beautiful.

seo.metaDescription: Experience authentic Japanese cuisine at Kaze. Seasonal menus, omakase dining, and effortless reservations. Book your table today.
